body.name: primal information-allocation relaxation
body.construction: Define \(\mathcal B(w)=\inf\{\sum_{\mathsf Q\in\mathscr A(w)}\sum_{a\in\mathcal A}z_{\mathsf Q,a}:z_{\mathsf Q}\in\mathcal R_{\mathsf Q}(w)\ \text{for every }\mathsf Q\in\mathscr A(w)\}\), with the infimum in the extended nonnegative reals.
